scope: same 192 serial independent P4/H8 contexts as finite_service; complete T10 common3 integer student, not whole-layer timing
algorithm: three shared prefix Y; C=Ucore-tau. Exactly one 12-bin signed private-Y interval permission. Failed private rows execute complete time-major Conv and C+d*Y gate. No remaining-count updates, eta division, or repeated bounds.

machine.W_port: read-only, one beat/step, one-step return; coefficient and nonzero mask share it
machine.state_port: one read OR write per step, one-step read return; Y, NRV, A/tau/eta/bounds and output all contend
machine.conv: 32 INT24 add lanes, one vector issue/step; source count and bound adds reuse these lanes
machine.psn: 8 signed24x16/48 MAC lanes, one vector issue/step, two-step dependent result; divide ALU/shift operations reuse them
machine.comparisons: 8 lanes, one vector issue/step; shared by exact gates, bounds and division correction
machine.source_header: one 64-bit word holds NRV length and the 10-bit OR of source time support, produced by the required source compaction pass
machine.Y_layout: p-major within each t row; 32x24bit row=12 beats, eight-h p vector=3 beats
machine.word_addresses: W64=(hg*864+k); mask64=82944/8+hg*108+floor(k/8). State Y byte offset=slot*96+p*24, eta=eta_base+private_index*64+p*16; both vector starts are 64-bit aligned. Candidate prefix/tail slots reuse storage after all core consumers finish.
machine.NRV_layout: 40 support bits + 10-bit k + flags in one actual 64-bit record; generated by an in-place ordered scan

state_allocation.lifetime: Y[0:288] contains three prefixes until every core is consumed; afterward its first 96 bytes may hold the only current private Y. C[288:1632] contains seven private rows of four H8 vectors, 48 bytes/vector. C is released after initial certification or final exact gate.
state_allocation.scratch: existing 48-byte bound/tau scratch = tau32 + L16; existing eta16 register = H16. One U48 and one operand24 only. No ten-row U bank.
state_allocation.metadata: live/output/zero metadata reuse the original register capacities; they are additionally included in this conservative 2KiB tally. Their bounded updates use existing sideband logic, as in finite_service.

policies: first endpoint uses the just-produced C in the single U register; C writes and restoration for the second endpoint are actual six-beat state operations
failed final gates reread C for six beats and use the same eight PSN MAC lanes for d*Y+C
L/U and tau remain simultaneously resident only by repartitioning existing scratch/eta registers, with no added register bytes
ordinary source/W product-empty lanes are exact before bounds; all source compaction/counts and W-mask intersections are charged
whole-vector zero bypasses use already-produced Y metadata; future Y values and golden gates never select requests
static W and parameter pools, 64-bit ports, multiplier latency and source endpoint are inherited unchanged
these are finite service-model completion steps, not RTL cycles, isoarea, PPA or system acceleration
